abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.1 | 4.5 | 550 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 8.7 | 4.3 | 550 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 9.2 | 4.6 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.8 | 4.4 | 550 |
